svg.title: EMS Relay AWS Serverless MVP Architecture
svg.desc: External EMS, dispatch, and hospital users access serverless web applications in AWS US West Oregon. Mobile push-to-talk audio streams directly to Amazon Transcribe without WAV persistence. Final transcripts pass through an HTTP API, Lambda, AgentCore Runtime, Amazon Bedrock, DynamoDB, human confirmation, external medical and routing APIs, real-time WebSocket fanout, reporting, FHIR R4 HealthLake, and observability.
svg.text: EMS Relay — AWS Serverless MVP Architecture
Region: US West (Oregon) · us-west-2 | Streaming voice input · Human-in-the-loop confirmation · No WAV persistence

g.text: • Agent output is a proposed JSON change set, never a transport or acceptance decision.
• EMS / dispatch confirms the shared snapshot; hospital staff submits the final response.
Raw audio is processed in memory and is not persisted to Amazon S3.

svg.text: No API is treated as real-time acceptance.
AWS Architecture Icons: official package 2026-04-30 · Diagram scope: hackathon MVP · Clinical decisions remain with authorized human users.
